name: Pinch analysis and heat integration
applications: heat recovery in refineries and chemical plants
retrofits of existing heat exchanger networks
principle: Hot and cold process streams are plotted as heat load against temperature and combined into composite curves; the point of closest approach is the pinch. Targets for minimum hot and cold utility follow, and exchangers are placed above and below the pinch separately.

process_steps.name: Extract hot and cold streams with heat load and temperatures
Build hot and cold composite curves
Locate the pinch at the chosen minimum temperature difference
Set minimum utility and area targets
Design heat exchanger network above and below the pinch

advantages: Gives a thermodynamic energy target before any network is designed
limitations: Large mixed-integer network optimisation problems remain hard to solve
